title: Building a Like-for-Like solution for Stores in Power BI
description: Like-for-Like (L4L) solutions are essential for comparing elements. It's about comparing only comparable elements, in this case, comparing stores over time. Let's see a solution built in a Semantic model. The post Building a Like-for-Like solution for Stores in Power BI appeared first on Towards Data Science .
author: Salvatore Cagliari
